title: Deeper/broader CADMPEG ACIS-profile semantic-reader qualification update
scope: Reconcile CADMPEG's published crate support level with its profile-specific ACIS/ASM decode claims
Separate a bare ACIS stream parser and connected neutral B-rep validation from a general geometry kernel
Distinguish ASM BinaryFile4/8 and save-format 23200 from the documented ACIS 217/218 carrier branch
Convert the candidate into a bounded, implementation-ready optional check without adding a routine dependency, fixture, or support claim

sources.name: cadmpeg-codec-sat 0.6.1 API
sources.observed: The crate describes a bare ASM/ACIS stream codec and reports L1 support. It is not a DWG or DXF document/container reader.

sources.name: CADMPEG format support and scoring criteria
sources.observed: The overall ASM/ACIS support score is L1, but the same support document records connected B-rep validation and direct-carrier parity as profile-specific extras for ACIS majors 217 and 218. The ladder is defined against declared format coverage; the headline must not erase narrow extras or be mistaken for all-profile semantics.

sources.name: CADMPEG ASM/ACIS format specification
sources.observed: The document distinguishes ASM BinaryFile4 and BinaryFile8 from ACIS 217/218 binary streams, describes topology ownership and centimeter-to-millimeter conversion, and states other ACIS save-format bands are outside the documented grammar.

sources.name: CADMPEG ASM/ACIS open items
sources.observed: The project maintains unresolved ACIS/ASM layout questions; this limits extrapolation from a narrow passing profile to general modeler support.

sources.name: acis-core profile-specific authoring and validation scope
sources.observed: The crate documents experimental source-free Asm23200MetricBox SAB authoring and explicitly distinguishes reference-closure validation from B-rep validity and a particular Inventor/ASM version. This ASM profile cannot be silently equated to ACIS 217/218.

sources.name: FreeCAD official DXF/3D importer scope
sources.observed: The stock DXF importer documentation states that ACIS/SAT 3D solids are not currently read; DWG conversion and the selected DXF importer remain separate route stages.

sources.name: acad-ts 3.3.0 package and reader configuration
sources.observed: The package describes itself as an ACadSharp port and names its base and last-compared upstream commits. The reader docs default failsafe to true and unknown entity/object retention to false. This refreshes an existing lineage classification; it adds no independent parser vote.

assessment.planImpact: Refines the existing optional PAR-07/S8 composed checkpoint: CADMPEG is a conditional profile-specific independent ACIS decoder and neutral-topology cross-check for an exact admitted bare stream, not a generic framing-only comparator. It does not establish a geometry-kernel certificate, DXF/DWG entity association, AcDs ownership, native FreeCAD acceptance, or general ACIS/SAB support. Exact artifact/profile and source-to-carrier identity gates are required; mismatch or unavailable routes self-unblock as NOT_QUALIFIED/NOT_AVAILABLE.

implementationReadyChecks: At the existing composed S8 checkpoint only, resolve the exact cadmpeg-codec-sat archive/integrity, matching source commit, cadmpeg-asm version, lockfile, toolchain/features, and license; audit implementation overlap with other ACIS parser candidates.
Inspect the stream magic, save-format word, and revision flags. Do not equate ASM BinaryFile4/8 or ASM 23200 with the verified ACIS 217/218 branch.

Require exact admitted branch/version, expected body count, complete required body/topology disposition, and no unexplained geometry-transfer loss. Mark unverified dialects, missing required topology, or geometry_not_transferred NOT_QUALIFIED.
Before detaching bytes, prove the entity-to-carrier join and hash the exact assembled payload. Keep DXF inline SAT, DXF ACDSDATA/SAB, DWG inline modeler, and DWG AcDs routes separate.

Compare parser output to independently declared units, placement, bounds, analytic measures, topology, orientation, and explicit tolerances; CADMPEG self-reports and self-round trips are not independent expected-value oracles.
Keep any kernel result, native Linux/Windows FreeCAD acceptance, and support-claim decision separate. If an optional route is unavailable, record that stage and proceed with local fast slices.
Do not add a routine dependency, CMake/CI integration, downloaded/persistent DWG/DXF/SAT/SAB fixture, or per-slice peer/full-suite run.
limitations: Primary documentation review only. CADMPEG source/artifact correspondence, dependency graph, exact stream-profile admission, runtime output, B-rep validity, and any native consumer were not independently executed or audited. Mutable main pages and a crate documentation page are candidate-scope evidence, not reproducible qualification. The local ODA v5.4.1 specification remains authoritative for DWG byte layout.
